name: South Dakota

labor.name: South Dakota Department of Labor & Regulation

entityTax: No corporate or individual income tax (financial institution franchise tax only)

permitFee.note: South Dakota charges no fee for a sales tax license.

penalty.note: 10% of the tax owed when the return is not received within 30 days after the month it was due, with a $10 minimum even if no tax is due.

workersComp.agency: South Dakota Division of Labor and Management
workersComp.threshold: Optional (not required by state law; uninsured employers can be sued in tort)

unemployment.note: $25 for each month or part of a month a quarterly report is late, up to $150 a report, plus 1.5% monthly interest.

newHire.note: No current official penalty amount for a late new hire report was found; secondary sources conflict or give only the federal $25 and $500 ceilings.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: No current official penalty amount for lacking required coverage was found; secondary sources conflict.

local.title: City business license
local.description: Some South Dakota cities require licenses for specific businesses.

industry.alcohol: South Dakota Department of Revenue (with local licensing)
industry.childCare: South Dakota Department of Social Services

cannabis.regulator: South Dakota Department of Health, Medical Cannabis Program
